title: Refresh the console from Git when realtime transport is unavailable
description:
## Problem

The console UI currently depends on its SSE/MQTT streams for changes. In the live project, MQTT returned connection refused and the UI retained stale data until the user manually reloaded the page. A stale or hung backend also surfaced only as an unhelpful Unable to reach the server banner.

## Required behavior

The console must refresh its API snapshot automatically when realtime transport is unavailable or silent. The fallback must use the existing Git-backed snapshot path, recover from a transient API failure, and clearly distinguish stale data from an unreachable server.

## Acceptance criteria

- MQTT/SSE failure starts bounded periodic snapshot refresh without manual reload.
- A successful fallback refresh clears the connection-error banner and updates cards/statuses.
- Git-backed external changes appear in the board within the configured refresh interval.
- Python/Rust console APIs and UI tests cover realtime outage, recovery, and no duplicate polling.
- Normal SSE/MQTT delivery remains primary and does not trigger redundant polling.
